div.div: Q. 1 فَرْطَحَ He made broad, or wide, (K,) or he spread out, or expanded, anything: and so فَلْطَحَ. (L.) Hence, فُرْطِحَ said of a round cake of bread, It was made broad, or wide: (S, L:) said by IB to be correctly فُلْطِحَ, and to be thus in a verse as related by El-Ámidee. (TA. [But see the pass. part. n., below.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
